## Read Trimming, Mapping, and SNP Calling

Using dDocent
Create a new working directory

```{bash}
cd /home/ccaillon
mkdir RISG_dDocent_working
cd RISG_dDocent_working
```

```{bash}
cd /home/ccaillon/RISG_dDocent_working
conda init
conda activate RISG_Seascape
ln -s ../dDocent_ngs .  #link dDocent file into this new working directory
ln -s ../../Shared_Data/RISG_Adults/final_demuliplexed_files_for_Coline/*.fq.gz . #link raw seq files into working directory
ln -s ~/eager_obj1b/Genome/masked.* reference.fasta #link new haplotig masked genome into working directory
```

### Run dDocent_ngs
```{bash}
dDocent_ngs
```
